title: Pointer copy with scoped pinning
prompt: Implement `static void CopyBytes(byte[] src, int srcOffset, byte[] dst, int dstOffset, int count)` using unsafe pointer arithmetic with `fixed` — pinning BOTH arrays for the copy. Correctness test does overlapping-free copies at offsets; the lesson: pin narrowly (only the fixed block), never store the pointers, never let them escape.

tests.name: copy-correct
tests.hint: fixed (byte* ps = src) fixed (byte* pd = dst) { for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) pd[dstOffset + i] = ps[srcOffset + i]; }

tests.name: empty-count
tests.hint: The for-loop condition handles it; fixed on an empty segment is legal.
